newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian army reports second huge cocaine bust.
newsitem.headline: Colombian army reports second huge cocaine bust.

text.p: Soldiers seized 3,300 pounds (1,500 kg) of high grade cocaine in a raid on a clandestine drug laboratory in Colombia's southeastern jungle on Wednesday, military sources said.

The find in Guaviare province, near the town of Miraflores, comes just two days after police and troops destroyed 1,600 pounds (725 kg) of cocaine and 630 pounds (287 kg) of cocaine paste in the same area.
A spokesman for the army's fourth brigade said the drug lab belonged to the leftist Revolutionary Armed Forces of Colombia (FARC) and had the capacity to produce five tons of cocaine a week.

Authorities say the FARC is Colombia's third drug cartel after the Cali and Medellin mafias. A FARC spokesman denied the rebel force was directly linked to narcotics production, but said it imposed a war tax on drug traffickers just as on wealthy industrialists.
